grants.title: HCLTech Grant — Water, Biodiversity & Environment
grants.description: Annual grant program from HCLFoundation for projects addressing water conservation, biodiversity protection, and environmental sustainability. Grants up to ₹5 Crore (~$600,000 USD). Open to registered NGOs and civil society organizations in India working on climate action and community resilience.

grants.title: Keidanren Nature Conservation Fund (KNCF) — Grant Program
grants.funder: Keidanren Nature Conservation Fund / Nippon Keidanren
grants.description: Annual grant program for biodiversity conservation projects in the Asia-Pacific region. Grants up to ¥20 million/year for projects focused on nature conservation, sustainable resource use, and biodiversity protection. Open to NGOs, research institutions, and community organizations in Asia-Oceania.

grants.title: Sasakawa Peace Foundation — Idea Submission Program
grants.description: Open call for idea submissions to the Sasakawa Peace Foundation. Focus areas: peacebuilding, maritime affairs, women in peace & security, US-Japan exchange, Middle East peace, and Pacific Islands development. Open to individuals, NGOs, and research institutions worldwide.
